evidence.appropriate: the quirk (the o's counter cut as an arch) carries the arch, not the piece that holds it; the one idea does not read
evidence.distinctive: a characterful grotesque with one quirk, but HoneyBook and Chaser are wordmark-only too, and the quirk disappears below 128 px
evidence.legible: the name reads at a glance; x-height 15.5 px in the 120 px wordmark; the o icon holds at 16 px
evidence.adaptable: no symbol: every app icon from 96 px up shows the whole word, against the brief's first surface (app icon); the o icon is a plain ring at 16 px
evidence.timeless: a custom wordmark with one quirk is on trends.md's use list
evidence.universal: mirrored and rotated are text; the o icon can read as a zero
evidence.clear: no look-alike search: killed before presenting
evidence.congruent: grotesk, heavy and title case match; frame (framed) and the icon's shape miss
evidence.system: the lockups collapse to the wordmark; the compact, small and favicon tiers draw the o

reason: The quirk carries the arch, not the piece that holds it, and a wordmark-only mark fails the first surface: every app icon from 96 px up would show the whole word. Giving it a symbol would make it a combination mark repeating 01 or 02, so appropriate cannot rise to 4 inside this direction.
